** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Keep the round-trip test compatible with Python 3.10.** The supplied `python/pyproject.toml` supports Python 3.10, but `BaseException.add_note()` was introduced in Python 3.11. On Python 3.10, each API exception case raises `AttributeError` before it checks serialization. ([docs.python.org](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/exceptions.html?utm_source=openai)) Guard both the `add_note()` call and the `__notes__` assertion with a capability check. Keep the other round-trip assertions active on Python 3.10.
